notes: 2605.10064 MAGE (seat Δ13.75): final 43.75 = son55 on every disputed rating (X 2, E.measurement 1, E.causality 1, E.holdout 2). son55's flagged inconsistencies are confirmed: Table 14 accuracies differ from Table 1 (GSM8K 84.2 vs 88.2, STBench 51.8 vs 54.8/57.8, RealMath 82.5 vs 85.1; Reflexion 12.0/11.5 vs 37.0/34.5), Table 4 gives 52 runs / 2.12% while §4.3 and Appendix N give 1.91% over thirty-six runs (the per-benchmark run counts sum to 42). Opus adds two contradictions neither seat recorded: Tables 12/13 put Crafter peaks at 23.4/22.7/22.7 (Llama) and 25.3/26.8/24.0 (Qwen), at or below the 25.5 standalone reference that §4.2 says every teacher configuration beats (Table 3: 33.5/37.9/34.8); Appendix Q says the Table 2 headline FinQA/MedQA values are 64.0–64.5 / 68.5, while Table 2 shows 67.5/74.6. The judge that scores the held-out pool is the same Sonnet 4.6 Critic that admits success memories during evolution. Causality: the only memory ablation is success-off; Table 17 shows 87% new-question accuracy at iteration 0 (no success memories yet) against a 64.5 0-shot base, so most of the gain may be scaffold, and no teacher-information-matched retrieval baseline exists. Domain → son55 H03 (flat task-filtered top-K over gated cases; Eq. 3 never reads the graph structure) + H00.

RS → son55 C25 primary (typed task_input → verified solver → credit-assigning verifier loop; w/o Tool Use −0.54) + heterogeneous_decomposition supporting.
